title: Who ate the Halloween candy?
title_zh: 谁偷吃了万圣节的糖果？

say.mum: Pebble, who ate ALL the candy?
say.answer: Mia. At 21:14 she swapped sheets with Leo — but her voice and pink sneakers gave her away.

ui.banner: Leo can't be in two places at once.

whoa.en: Whoa… Mia, the candy's over there!

hehe.en: Hehe — I'm Sam, by the way.

cantsee.en: I can't see a thing in this.

phew.en: Phew. I'll get us some juice.

oneforme.en: One for me… one more for me…

whoate.en: Pebble… who ate ALL the candy?

answer.en: It was Mia. At 21:14 she swapped sheets with Leo — her giggle and pink sneakers gave her away.
answer.zh: 是 Mia。21:14 她和 Leo 换了床单——但她的笑声和粉色球鞋出卖了她。

mumrule.en: One candy each tonight — the rest is for tomorrow!
mumrule.zh: 今晚每人只能吃一颗，剩下的留到明天！

ketchup.en: Aw, ketchup! I can't see a thing in this.
ketchup.zh: 啊，番茄酱！套着这个啥也看不见。

sheet.en: Candy wrappers stuck all over YOUR ketchup sheet, Leo!
sheet.zh: 你那张番茄酱床单上粘满了糖纸，Leo！

mum2.en: Pebble, you saw everything. Who was it?

answer2.en: It was Mia. In the blackout she put on Leo's ketchup sheet — but her giggle and pink sneakers gave her away.
answer2.zh:
是 Mia。停电时她换上了 Leo 那张沾番茄酱的床单——
但她的笑声和粉色球鞋出卖了她。

sticky.en: Ew, it's all sticky! I'll put it back on later.
sticky.zh: 咦，黏糊糊的！我待会儿再穿。
